text:
emma_cs: FYI — SpectraHealth just flagged a request: Clinical Insights (new analytics team) wants to onboard next month for a doc-ingest + embeddings pilot. They estimate ~2-3M tokens/day after PoC :thinking_face:

sam_csm: awesome signal. do we have a sandbox org for them or should we spin a dedicated environment?

raj_solutions: recommend a dedicated sandbox w/ vector-store demo. embeddings + semantic search will need >baseline qps for short bursts. can we support 3M/day in their current dedicated pool?

lina_engineer: current Dedicated pool for spectra is sized for their product team only. 3M/day sustained would push past autoscale thresholds. we could enable burst capacity for 2 weeks during pilot — need SRE signoff.

ana_success_mgr: @emma_cs when is renewal? i want to map MTTR -> renewal conversations if this goes well.

emma_cs: renewal in ~9 weeks. positive pilot = strong expansion story. also capture feedback on latency for vector lookups.

sam_csm: action items: 1) raj to draft sandbox infra plan. 2) lina to estimate cost delta for burst windows. 3) ana to prep enablement deck + onboarding checklist. i'll schedule a kickoff w/ Spectra next Tue.

raj_solutions: putting a quick config snippet here for the sandbox proposal:
```
- cluster: dedicated-spectra-sandbox
- gpu: a10g x2
- routing: prefer-low-latency, fallback: quantized-variant
- caching: prefix-kv enabled
- embeddings: ada-embed-1 (quantized), vector-store: pinecone (trial)
```

lina_engineer: estimate: burst 2x baseline => ~$4k/week additional infra during pilot. if they want sustained, we should propose Reserved capacity or a small Dedicated bump.

ops_bot: [alert] quota check: spectraorg-prod usage 7d avg = 0.9M tokens/day, projected with new team = 3.1M tokens/day. Recommend quota uplift request.

ana_success_mgr: I'll add a slide on ROI + renewal timing. also capture CSAT touchpoints at week 1 and week 3 of pilot.

emma_cs: thanks. raj/lina please drop estimates here by EOD Friday so i can share in kickoff. Sam will send invite.

sam_csm: invite sent for Tue 10am PT. included product, infra, and Spectra lead. :calendar:
